crossRefs.note: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and…
Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to…
The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of…
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
translations.bsb: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
translations.kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
translations.asv: When God heard this, he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;
